name: oci-atlas
description: Packaged Oracle Cloud Infrastructure knowledge, service selection, and practical workflows for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Understand OCI services, choose architectures, navigate a tenancy, and work through resource tasks using your available OCI CLI or signed-in browser. Loads focused, sourced knowledge only when needed. Requires your own OCI access for live operations.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand my OCI tenancy and choose the right services.
Plan and provision an OCI workload using my available tools.
Investigate an OCI issue and explain what to check next.
